articles.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drones in Libya, Zelensky says
articles.description: The Kremlin warns of an "escalation of tensions in the region", but declines to comment directly on the attacks in Libya.

articles.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
articles.description: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.

articles.title: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says
articles.description: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.

articles.title: Flights cancelled in Belgium due to cost-of-living strike
articles.description: A series of strikes have hit Belgium in recent months as the prime minister struggles to agree a budget to cut costs.

articles.title: Mexican soldiers attacked in wake of drug lord's arrest
articles.description: Eight suspects are arrested after firing on soldiers trying to re-establish order following the arrest of 'El Chapo Isidro'.

articles.title: Kenya and DR Congo agree to restore ties after tensions over conflict
articles.description: The two leaders committed to upholding sovereignty and "non-interference in the internal affairs of states".

articles.title: Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble hours after Russian strike on Ukraine, rescuers say
articles.description: Eleven people are dead in the attack on Dymer, with rescue efforts ongoing to find those still missing from the residential building.

articles.title: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
articles.description: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on Saturday. Kyiv has yet to comment.
